draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.99, the 134th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 18th of 37 at CB. He went 123rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Corey White. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (87th percentile), vertical jump (88th percentile). College production: 6 passes defended in 2020, 12th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams (day-to-day). 33 career games and 1 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 1 AV in 2022. Weak spots: season snap share 8.9% (16th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 8.9% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, below the norm.
